description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different audio categories within the MMAR benchmark, with each segment representing a distinct type of audio content and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment is "Speech," which accounts for 29.4% of the dataset and is colored in a medium purple. The second largest is "Music," making up 20.6% and shown in a slightly lighter purple. "Sound" follows with 16.5%, depicted in a very light purple. "Mix-Music-Speech" constitutes 8.2% and is represented by a darker purple. The smallest segments are "Mix-Sound-Music" at 2.4% and "Mix-Sound-Music-Speech" at 1.1%, both shown in the lightest purple and very small wedges. The chart uses a color gradient from light to dark purple to differentiate the categories, and each segment is labeled with its name and percentage value, with the percentages summing to 78.2% of the total, indicating that the remaining 21.8% is not explicitly categorized in this visualization.
